title: ApiTaskAllocation
description: A single API Task allocation record indicating an allocated real-time API Task

fileId.description: Numeric file ID of the API Task bot in the repository

filePath.description: Repository path of the allocated API Task (e.g., /Automation/MyApiTask)

fileName.description: Display name of the API Task file

runAsUserOrNone.description: User ID under which the API Task executes, or null if using the caller's credentials

concurrencyLimit.description: Maximum number of concurrent instances allowed for this API Task in real-time execution mode
